sections.title: Internship: Community Archiving in Theory and Praxis
sections.description: This course covers theoretical and practical aspects of archiving materials from community organizations. It discussions of theoretical readings on the history, praxis, and ethics of community archiving with practical hands-on experience archiving materials owned community partners. Students also learn from and work with curators, librarians, and conservationists at the Kislak Center for Special Collections.
